data.title: 夜莺 · 纸鹤
data.description: 翅膀折得一高一低，她小心地把纸展开，重新沿折痕压平。
data.camera: 中近景，纸鹤与双手清晰
data.promptProse: At a low wooden tea table in a peaceful meditation room, Nightingale meticulously folds an iridescent white origami crane with her slender fingertips. A simple ceramic vase holding a single flowering branch and a bamboo water basin outside the open sliding screen complete a serene setting of gentle healing.
data.animaCaption: Seated at a low wooden table in a tranquil meditation room, she folds a crisp white origami crane with slender fingertips. Soft natural light from the open sliding screen warms the ceramic flower vase beside her.
